result.quote: If you were to give me half your possessions, I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.
result.reason: The key is supported as a paraphrase, but the question broadly asks what the man says. His reply also includes that he would not eat or drink there and explains the LORD’s command, so multiple materially different answers are defensible. The wording should specify which part of his reply is sought.
